(còn gọi Soleil Ánh Dương Đà Nẵng) là tổ: (also known as Soleil Anh Duong Da Nang) is a hotel apartment and 5-star hotel complex developed by PPC An Thinh Da Nang JSC, managed and operated by Wyndham Hotel Group and designed by Aedas. The project covers about 21,800 m² at 02 Pham Van Dong – Vo Nguyen Giap (Son Tra) and comprises 4 towers: the hotel and 3 hotel apartment towers A1, A2 (57 storeys) and D (50 storeys).
